All four face the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of #1's head down to the line of #4's shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them. Every face is large and sharp. All of them stand together in one single shared scene in front of the same continuous background, and this is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, not a collage: the women overlap slightly in depth and the background runs unbroken behind all of them. Pose: all four women stand upright, arms relaxed, heads level and facing the camera; #2 and #3 lean very slightly toward the centre, #4 leans very slightly forward, and #1 stands tall in the gap behind them. The hanging ear pieces of #1, #2 and #3 end no lower than the level of their own chins so that they hang in clear view, those of #4 hang in front of her own neck and shoulder down to the level of her collarbones, and no hanging piece of one woman hangs in front of another woman's face. There is no dividing line between the women, and no different light, colour or background on different women.

Lighting: The background is a misty forest at dusk, soft blurred dark-green trees fading into pale fog, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no other people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than their faces so that their faces and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from their skin tones, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. One single light setup lights everyone from the same direction with the same colour, so the shadows and highlights match on every woman. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 vertical 8K.
